admission.authority: staged admission (gate report plus package-digest binding); the host mints no receipt at execution time
admission.gate_report: the authority's sealed BootstrapProfileReport for the closure (constructible only by judge_bootstrap_profile; fields immutable outside the gate): entry-first function must equal the package entry, the admitted import set must equal the package import-identity set, operation/bridge counts must equal the digested gate_operation_count/gate_bridge_uses, closure fingerprints must equal the digested gate_closure_fingerprints, and the committed admitted_image_digest must equal the package image digest re-derived by approval and execution; all verified without running the gate; graphs-to-image correspondence is the admission authority's reference re-lowering comparison (RW-080 contract), not host work; no report exists for gate-refused (out-of-bootstrap) closures
admission.stale_package: refuses: recomputed package digest differs from the receipt binding

approved_binding.limits_rule: the execution request limits must equal admitted_limits exactly; out-of-profile budgets refuse with PACKAGE_BINDING_MISMATCH
approved_binding.observation_domain: SLEYPOBS1 (distinct from legacy SLEYOBS1; package observations can never equal legacy observations)
approved_binding.successor_of: ApprovedImage (which bound only digest plus cache key plus import IDs); ApprovedImage is preserved as superseded history and remains functional for the legacy path

bounds.dependency_note: sections are sub-budgets inside the total envelope ceiling, not additions to it
bounds.envelope_total: sum of image plus all section bytes is at most package_max_bytes; enforced in package_digests independently of per-section ceilings

envelope.package_digest_preimage: SLEYPKG1 || u32(2) || profile_digest(v2) || host_abi_version(2) || vm_version || image_digest || constants_digest || layouts_digest || imports_digest || dependency_digest || entry || epoch || root (SHA-256)
sections: dependency (entry, epoch, root, profile, VM/lowerer versions, admitted limits, globals, contracts)
envelope.version: u32 big-endian, must equal 2 (successor; v1 envelope version 1 preserved as history)

frozen_references.image_format: SLEYBC02 version 1 (unchanged; the envelope wraps it, never redefines it)

allows: structural layout hydration (duplicate-identity and count bounds only)
hydration.constructor: TypeEnvironment::hydrate_verified_definitions (duplicate plus count bound only; never TypeEnvironment::new on this path)
forbids: repair or inference of missing layout data

negative_corpus: correct image plus wrong import row
correct image plus wrong admission receipt
observation from another image or package
broader-profile operation in a bootstrap package
profile: EXTENDED_V1 (the package path requires exactly EXTENDED_V1; BOOTSTRAP_PROFILE_1 is bound by digest, never broadened)
rw075: corrective subpackage depending on RW-070; blocking prerequisite for RW-080; not a feature campaign

supersedes.relation: same envelope layout/bounds; version field 2, profile_digest v2, host_abi_version 2; v1 preserved byte-identical as history
